questions.question: When is Christmas celebrated in UK/USA?
questions.explanation: In English-speaking countries, Christmas is celebrated on December 25th.

questions.question: What do children do on Halloween?
questions.explanation: On Halloween (October 31st), children dress up and go trick-or-treating for candy.

questions.question: Which holiday is in late November in the USA?
questions.explanation: Thanksgiving is an American holiday in late November with family dinner and turkey.

questions.question: Hva betyr "Merry Christmas"?
questions.explanation: "Merry Christmas!" is the greeting used at Christmas time.

questions.question: What animal is associated with Easter?
questions.explanation: The Easter bunny is associated with Easter and brings chocolate eggs.
